about: The ballots people can pick in the app's single location drop-down. Each ballot points to one election file, data/<state>/<locality>/<date>.json, and fixes the districts that ballot covers (the ids and values must exist in that file's "districts" list). To offer a new place or ballot type, add its data files and one entry here.

ballots.label: San Luis Obispo, CA · Nov 3, 2026
ballots.note: Matches San Luis Obispo County Ballot Type 26: City of San Luis Obispo, U.S. House District 24, State Assembly District 30. Check that the header of your own sample ballot matches.

ballots.label: Goshen, IN (Concord 33) · Nov 3, 2026
ballots.note: Matches Elkhart County precinct Concord 33: U.S. House District 2, State House District 21, Commissioner District 1, Council District 4, Concord Township, Concord Community Schools District 1. Check the precinct on the Indiana Voters portal.
